name: Public Storage
why: Largest U.S. self-storage operator (absorbed NSA/iStorage/SecurCare/Simply); dossier from an earlier run kept.

name: Extra Space Storage
why: Largest U.S. operator by store count (~4,000 stores incl. former Life Storage).

name: CubeSmart
why: Third-largest public storage REIT (~1,500 stores), detailed public fee schedule.

name: U-Haul Self-Storage
why: One of the largest national storage operators; household-name brand.

name: PODS
why: Best-known portable storage container brand with monthly storage rent billing.

name: StorageMart
why: Largest privately held U.S. storage operator (incl. Manhattan Mini Storage).

name: SmartStop Self Storage
why: Public REIT operating in ~20 states; documented payment and move-out rules.

name: StorQuest Self Storage
why: Large multi-state operator (CA, AZ, CO, FL, TX and more) with published billing FAQ.

name: 10 Federal Storage
why: Fast-growing contactless operator in the Southeast/Midwest with its own Customer Portal and Quick Pay.

name: Dignity Memorial (SCI)
why: Largest U.S. funeral/cemetery provider; online bill pay for pre-need installment contracts.

name: Everstory Partners
why: Largest U.S. cemetery operator after SCI (formerly StoneMor); Paymentus customer payment platform for pre-need contracts with documented AutoPay and surcharge rules.

name: Storage Rentals of America
why: Large multi-state operator (~200 stores) with a detailed public billing/account FAQ.

name: Safeguard Self Storage
why: Established operator in the Northeast, South and Midwest; Online Service Center with documented payment rules.

name: Morningstar Storage
why: Large Southeast/Southwest operator; new payment portal with guest pay and published 2% card fee.

name: Store Space Self Storage
why: Multi-state operator with a help center covering due dates, late fees, AutoPay and move-out; RapidPay guest payment.

name: Devon Self Storage
why: National operator (~70 stores) with an FAQ on payment, due date and move-out notice.

name: Compass Self Storage
why: Amsdell's national brand (~100 stores) with online payment portal and autopay.

name: Storage Sense
why: Southeast operator with a Pay Bill portal and published discount/lease FAQ.

name: Go Store It
why: Fast-growing Charlotte-based operator using the StoreEase tenant portal (phone-link login, Quick Payment).

name: 1-800-PACK-RAT
why: Major national portable storage brand (incl. Zippy Shell) with My PackRat online account.
